claim: Briyo applies a four-stage quality testing process: raw material review before production, in-process checks during manufacturing, final release review, and ongoing stability testing.
quoted_support: Quality is reviewed before, during and after manufacturing — not only at the end.

claim: Briyo tests each batch of raw materials for identity, purity, and potency before use in production, and reviews finished products for dosage accuracy, physical integrity, and appearance before release.
stance_target: Briyo ingredient discipline and finished-product standards
quoted_support: Ingredients and packaging components are reviewed before production for identity, potency, purity and relevant safety parameters. Before release, dosage accuracy, physical integrity, appearance and applicable performance parameters are reviewed.

claim: Briyo's product formats include capsules, chewables (tablets), and single-serve sachets, designed for daily routine convenience.
quoted_support: Capsules – Compact and easy to make part of a daily routine. Chewables – A convenient format made for simpler supplementation. Sachets – Precision-dosed servings for home, work or travel.

claim: Briyo conducts stability testing to confirm products remain within specification throughout their stated shelf life.
quoted_support: Stability checks help confirm that products remain compliant with their specifications throughout the stated shelf life.
